name: @superschematic/rules
description: The pure core of the behaviors (D103) built for WebAssembly: superschematic-rules with the behaviors ported onto it, run over its JSON contract (a type, a command and the answers so far in, a step out) in Bun, Node and Workers, with the registered behaviors' declarations and a define check of a layout's types. The HTTP runtime's adapter (@superschematic/http-runtime) runs its host loop over it. Ships the compiled ESM and the wasm module.

scripts.test: bun run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && bun test test && node test/node.mjs
